description: This file defines the WorkScheduleService class, which manages work schedule objects for employees within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It handles retrieving and instantiating the appropriate work schedule implementation class, with caching to optimize repeated access.

classes.name: WorkScheduleService
classes.description: Service class responsible for providing employee work schedule instances, implementing caching, class resolution, and instantiation logic.

methods.name: getWorkSchedule
methods.description: Returns a WorkScheduleInterface for the specified employee number, creating and caching it if necessary.
